SVG is rendered through ``, > and Markdown is sanitized before display."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Supported file types"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Type | Renderer |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| PNG / JPG / GIF / WEBP / SVG / BMP | Image (fit, zoom, pan, dimensions) | | PDF | PDF.js (page nav"},{"id":"p10s2","text":", page input, zoom, fit width/page) | | CSV / TSV | Data table (delimiter auto-detect, sticky header"},{"id":"p10s3","text":", row numbers, search, sort, column resize, windowed rows, chunked loading) | | TXT / LOG / OUT / IN"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"I / CONF | Text (line numbers, wrap, search, font size, chunk navigation) | | JS / TS / Python / Go "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"/ Rust / Java / C/C++ / C# / Shell / HTML / CSS / SQL / … | Code (highlight.js, read-only) | | Markd"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"own | Preview (sanitized) + Source | | JSON / JSONL | Tree (expand/collapse, copy value/path) + Sour"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ce | | YAML | Source + parsed Tree | | anything else | Fallback (metadata + Open externally / Reveal"},{"id":"p10s8","text":" / Copy path / optional Open as text) |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Host half** (`dist/index.js`) registers the `/fileviewer` authenticated RPC channel and exposes "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"both a `fileViewerContent` provider registry and a `fileViewerHost` bounded service for trusted tran"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"sport plugins. The viewer does not assume content lives in a local folder: other host plugins can re"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"gister readers for locators such as `artifact://run/report.json`, object storage, generated output, "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"or remote APIs. A boundary-checked `ctx.fs` provider is installed only when that service is availabl"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"e; on the DSH v0.1.2+ package graph it discovers workspace roots from `ctx.workspaceRegistry`, live "},{"id":"p12s7","text":"session cwd values from `ctx.sessions`, and native open support from `ctx.sessionController`. - **Cl"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"ient half** (`dist/client.js`) provides the `fileViewer` service (`ctx.get('fileViewer')` → `openFil"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"e(path, { line, renderer })`) and renders the viewer as a `conversation.view` tab beside Chat and Tr"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"ajectory. It opens from: - produced-file chips in the conversation (`conversation.chat.turnTail`, pr"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"iority -1 — clicking an agent-generated file previews it in-app), or - the **"浏览文件 / Browse files"**"},{"id":"p12s12","text":" entry added to each workspace row's "…" menu (see the compatibility patch below). - **Workspace "…""},{"id":"p12s13","text":" menu patch** (`scripts/patch-workspace-menu.mjs`): the workspace browser renders its row menu from "},{"id":"p12s14","text":"a hardcoded list with no slot hook, so this script applies guarded, idempotent edits either to a `de"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"epseek-harness` source checkout (verified through `dsh-v0.1.5-rc.1`) or to an installed `@deepseek-a"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"i/dsh-client-ui-workspace` client bundle. It adds a `browseFiles` menu item (zh/en labels), an `onSe"},{"id":"p12s17","text":"lect` branch calling `window.__dsfvBrowseWorkspace(workspaceId)`, and the dictionary keys. It aborts"},{"id":"p12s18","text":" loudly on version drift and can be re-run safely after Harness updates (`DSH_HARNESS_SOURCE=/path/t"},{"id":"p12s19","text":"o/deepseek-harness node scripts/patch-workspace-menu.mjs`). - **Large-file strategy**: `< 5 MB` whol"},{"id":"p12s20","text":"e-file, `5–50 MB` chunked streaming, `> 50 MB` head-only with explicit "Load more / Go to end" navig"},{"id":"p12s21","text":"ation. Range reads are capped (8 MiB per call) and text/CSV rows are windowed, so a 500 MB log never"},{"id":"p12s22","text":" lands in browser memory. On rc2 the host RPC channel is registered with an explicit loopb"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ack authority and workspace discovery uses the legacy `apiProxy` fallback. On v0.1.2+ the viewer add"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"itionally uses `ctx.workspaceRegistry`, `ctx.sessions`, and `ctx.sessionController`. The client meta"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"data depends only on packages shared by the supported graphs; their transitive dependencies provide "},{"id":"p14s6","text":"the generation-specific runtime services. On v0.1.2+ the viewer also accepts the `conversation.view`"},{"id":"p14s7","text":" focus request and treats its opaque focus value as a file locator."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"DSH and React packages are host-provided optional peer dependencies for this plugin. This is require"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"d by v0.1.2+ profiles, which keep peer auto-install disabled (`autoInstallPeers: false`): installing"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" the plugin must not add or require a second copy of the in-box platform packages. Because npm semve"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"r does not match later prereleases such as `0.1.5-rc.1` through `>=0.1.2-alpha.1 <0.2.0`, the peer r"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"anges explicitly include `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.2.0`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The Workspace row Browse entry remains a compatibility patch because upstream `@deepseek-ai/dsh-clie"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"nt-ui-workspace` has no third-party menu slot.
